originalExecution.label: estate-9b2ff121-svg-pieces-original-course-01
originalExecution.fitCountSemantics: Selected fixed helper control flow and mode-specific receipts; not independent dynamic tracing.

method.method: Independent point-light projection at authored keys; cell-center point-in-polygon classification with half-open y and strict x crossing; Boolean union over projected pieces.
method.score: XOR cell count divided by union cell count between predicted and target masks.
method.containment: Every target and predicted polygon vertex must be inside the observation window; no outside-window clipping credit.
method.thresholdMeaning: Prechosen practical two-percentage-point improvement and per-key guard, not a floating-point tolerance or promised outcome.
method.configurationLimit: Original single construction used lightShare .65; the new pieces construction uses fixed light with share zero. This compares whole constructions, not the isolated causal effect of piece count.
method.artifacts: Retain raw 0/1 byte masks, projected polygon coordinates, occupancy, XOR and union counts for target, original single and new pieces at both authored keys.

defaultMode.scope: One new compatible triangle translation fixture; not a replay or general regression qualification.

piecesNativeReport.scope: The maintained fitter uses its own measurement setup. This report is distinct from the shared independent authored-key comparison. Intermediate boundary morph is an authoring choice, not observed ground truth.

movie.foregroundCriterion: Pillow luminance <128, nonempty and no classified foreground at image edges.

independentDataReview.scope: Recounted all retained binary masks; verified 108 staged source hashes, before/after records, baseline, retained inputs, mode/refusal receipts, command streams, project/scene/movie hash chain, saved 96-frame geometry/schedules, original timing log, selected PNG and contact-sheet hashes.
independentDataReview.limits: Did not regenerate masks from polygons or decode the movie again. Full decoded RGB was not retained; per-frame RGB hashes and foreground measurements remain original receiver observations.

root.scope: All 96 consecutive decoded thumbnails in four contact sheets and full frame 95.
root.observed: The square progressively narrows into a recognizable triangular outline with visible square-cover stair steps. No blank, disappearing, clipped or abruptly displaced thumbnail was observed.
root.methodLimit: Framewise inspection, not real-time playback or full-resolution acceptance of every frame.

model_research.scope: All 96 consecutive decoded thumbnails in four ordered contact sheets and full frames 0,47,48,95.
model_research.observed: Accepted with visible approximation: no blank/disappearing or visibly clipped thumbnail, no abrupt whole-shape jump, consistent progression across frames 47/48, and a solid union in selected full frames. Final sides have pronounced stair steps and the apex is slightly flat.
model_research.methodLimit: Framewise inspection, not real-time playback or continuous-time framing.

sourcePreservation.originalStatusRecordsPreserved: The pre-execution protocol remains prospective historical source. The original raw result keeps its pending visual-review marker; later reviews are separate.

limits: One finite fixture and fixed observation grid do not establish universal SVG improvement or continuous geometry equivalence.
Original single used lightShare .65 and new pieces used zero; this does not isolate the causal effect of piece count.
Twenty-one pieces and 84 vertices replace one piece and four vertices. Authored shape improvement comes with greater physical complexity.
The final triangle remains a stepped approximation and intermediate target mismatch remains substantial.
Finite frame bounds and luminance tests do not establish continuous framing, perceptual smoothness, collision clearance or fabrication feasibility.
Lossless YUV encoding does not imply RGB or browser pixel identity.
No browser gate, performance benchmark, model inference or public Release is established by this course.
